description: This PHP source file defines the SaveReportingMethodController class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the pre-render logic for reporting method components, distinguishing between editing an existing reporting method and creating a new one based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveReportingMethodController
classes.description: Controller class managing the component rendering logic for saving or editing reporting methods in the HRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by selecting either an edit or save component based on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request.
